what: HIGH (code audit AUD-20260927-CA-B01-multiclass-served-score-is-max-proba): MulticlassPredictor.predict (the score ShadowPredictor logs and attribution/c_reg consume) returns max(predict_proba), which is symmetric in the class: a regime head logs ~0.9 for both 'confidently range' and 'confidently volatile', and a 'won'-target head logs 0.958 for a near-certain loss and 0.961 for a near-certain win — and conviction-meta-v1, a multiclass 'won' head, is at SHADOW in the live registry, so its attribution AUC/brier demote triggers are computed on a direction-less score. LOCATION: ml/predictors/multiclass.py:38-43; ml/predictors/shadow.py:103; consumers src/runtime/shadow_adapter.py:176, src/runtime/conviction_inputs.py:128-147, ml/calibration/regime_alignment.py:94-107, ml/promotion/attribution.py. PROPOSED FIX: Declare positive_class in model_state/manifest; make predict return P(positive_class) (or log the full proba dict in the shadow record); recompute attribution for affected heads and refit any regime_alignment calibrator.
